posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.text: I am now heading to China, from the Philippines, where we had a wonderful meeting on Trade, National Security, and other subjects. I am pleased to announce that we made a new and completely different Trade Deal with the Philippines, one that will be a true landmark and, in particular, a Deal that will be great for our Farmers and those in the business of “Energy.” President Marcos is a powerful leader, and a man of high integrity and substance. It was an Honor to be with him, and his beautiful wife and son. See you in China! President DONALD J. TRUMP

posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
Pennsylvania health officials reported another measles-associated death, bringing the state’s death toll to eight. 

The unvaccinated resident tested positive for measles and died, the Pennsylvania Department of Health said.
posts.text_ko:

펜실베니아 보건부는 백신을 접종하지 않은 주민이 홍역 양성 판정을 받고 사망했다고 밝혔다.

posts.name: The Washington Post
posts.text:
The Justice Department filed charges against a former Pennsylvania State University student and alleged drug-trafficking ringleader.

Agostino Abbatiello was charged with one count of conspiracy to distribute cocaine and six counts of distribution of cocaine.
posts.text_ko:
법무부는 전 펜실베니아 주립대학교 학생이자 마약 밀매 주동자로 의심되는 사람을 기소했습니다.

Agostino Abbatiello는 1건의 코카인 배포 음모 혐의와 6건의 코카인 배포 혐의로 기소되었습니다.
